conditions.support: Specific objective conditions constrain plans; recognition guides action through practice and changes with facts. This anchors application questions, not a full philosophical definition of matter.

people.support: Mass social practice is not fame alone; individual contribution is evaluated with collective action and conditions, not declared universally zero or omnipotent.

interaction.support: Historical results involve interacting actions and conditions; they need not reproduce any one wish or all wishes unchanged.

instruments.support: Labour instruments mediate action on the labour subject; an oven is an instrument in baking and paper is the processed subject in printing.
